pages.lesson:
LESSON: MOVEMENT OF MATERIALS IN AND OUT OF THE CELL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 2.2: Movement of Materials in and out of the cell

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do materials move in and out of a cell?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
2. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell in the examples.
2. Explain Movement of Materials in and out of the cell to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Movement of Materials in and out of the cell important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Use print and non-print material to search for information on the processes involved in the movement of materials in and out of a cell, discuss with peers (cover diffusion and osmosis),
2. Carry out experiments to demonstrate osmosis using visking tubing and plant materials, and share their findings with peers,
3. Communication and Collaboration: the learner acquires writing skills while recording findings from experiments to demonstrate diffusion and osmosis.
4. Self-efficacy: the learner executes assigned tasks successfully while carrying out experiments to demonstrate diffusion and osmosis. Values:
5. Respect: the learner appreciates the opinions of peers when discussing the roles of diffusion and osmosis in living things.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
2. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
